title: Kotak Mahindra Bank — First Custodian to Issue Fully Digital FPI Licence
summary: Kotak Mahindra Bank becomes India's first custodian to issue end-to-end electronic FPI (foreign portfolio investors holding liquid assets) licences via SEBI's CAF portal within 24 hours.

items: Kotak Mahindra Bank became **India's first custodian bank to issue a Foreign Portfolio Investor (FPI (foreign portfolio investors holding liquid assets)) licence completely digitally** via Digital Signature Certificates.
